default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-758.title: Rolling-median cross with rising median
E-758.hypothesis: The median of recent closes ignores spikes; a close crossing a sloping median means the typical price level is migrating, so stop-based traders chase the direction.

E-759.title: VWAP chop then break
E-759.hypothesis: Many crossings of the VWAP mean balanced trade; a close far from VWAP after the chop signals the balance resolving and trapped counter-traders adding to the move.

E-760.title: Efficiency-ratio trend onset
E-760.hypothesis: When net movement becomes a large share of the path travelled, flow is one-sided; follow the first bar where the Kaufman efficiency ratio crosses the threshold.

E-761.title: Widest bar of the session so far
E-761.hypothesis: A bar wider than every earlier bar of the day, closing at its extreme in its own colour, shows the strongest aggression of the session; the other side is forced to cover.

E-762.title: Same-colour big-body burst count
E-762.hypothesis: Several large same-direction bodies in a short window with none against show persistent institutional execution that slices orders; follow the burst.

E-763.title: Early-bias VWAP side follow
E-763.hypothesis: A session whose first bars were mostly one colour has a directional bias; after the opening window, the first close on the bias side of VWAP is a dip-buy/rally-sell by trend participants.

E-764.title: MACD histogram early turn
E-764.hypothesis: A histogram that rises for several bars while still below zero shows selling momentum fading before the lines cross; the early turn catches the reversal ahead of lagging followers.

E-765.title: CCI re-entry fade
E-765.hypothesis: A Commodity Channel Index excursion beyond a large threshold followed by a return inside it marks exhausted extension; fade back toward the mean.

E-766.title: Choppiness-index trend onset
E-766.hypothesis: A fall of the choppiness index below its trending threshold means ranges stop overlapping; follow the net direction of the window.

E-767.title: Force-index thrust
E-767.hypothesis: Price change times volume, smoothed, beyond a typical-size threshold shows volume-backed pressure; follow the first bar where it exceeds that size.
